rules.statement: A person who claims property on the ground that they obtained a transfer from the mortgagor after the registration of lis pendens in a hypothecary action is not entitled to possess the property as against the purchaser at an execution sale.
rules.supporting_quote: Where mortgaged property is sold in execution of a hypothecary decree in a case in which the purchaser would be entitled to an order for delivery of possession in terms of section 54 of the Mortgage Act, a person who claims the property on the ground that he obtained a transfer of it from the mortgagor after the registration of the lis pendens of the hypothecary action is not entitled to possess the property as against the purchaser at the execution sale.
